text_block_list.text: —The day of the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's that time of year again... the Takarazuka Kinen.
Personally, I've got my eyes on McQueen~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going with Ikuno Dictus this time!
After that brutal rotation starting from the Yasuda Kinen, I just can't wait to see how she does—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —That was over in a flash, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The race rotation that began with the Osaka Hai
leading up to today...
It was extremely packed and grueling, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I had a wonderful time, truly.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"In order to finish the race and get results,
I talked with Trainer and trained—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of those days...
Every single race... was truly so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: For letting me run so much.

......As a Trainer,
nothing could make me happier.

I desperately fight back the tears of gratitude
welling up in my eyes, thankful beyond words
to truly be her Trainer.
Because right now, the time hasn't come yet.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I will show it to all of you today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "The possibility for us... for our future, to continue running forward."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'm heading out.
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey... did Ikuno Dictus really just run the Yasuda Kinen...?
Doesn't she look totally unfatigued...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That's Ikuno Dictus for you...!
Man, she really is incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I will crash it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everything I have honed up to this day.
Every single bit of it, for you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Will you catch me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes—
Of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I shall face you with the very best running I have to offer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
――This is a showdown.
Ikuno Dictus-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I will be taking the victory.
Mejiro McQueen.
